name: io.github.hsu-aut/aml-mcp
description: Reads CAEX 3.0, CAEX 2.15 and AMLX documents; writes new CAEX 3.0 documents when allowed.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: Restrict reading to this directory. Repeat for more than one.

packageArguments.name: --write
packageArguments.description: Allow writing new .aml documents into this directory. Repeat for more than one. Without it the server writes nothing.
